about_the_game:
The letter you're reading now says something like...

"Sup. Congrats on becoming THE SATAN himself. Now, following our traditions, you need to MARRY THE WITCH.

COVEN prepared THE GREATEST OF THEM ALL for you. Come by THE CURSED MANSION ASAP."

You're not THE SATAN and found this letter on the street purely by accident. But who cares? Getting a wife out of nowhere is sick, so you've decided to give it a try... and found your future wife sealed inside THE MACHINE so she wouldn't destroy herself because of the abyssal madness inside. Now your goal is to fix THE WITCH and escape THE MACHINE, preferably married. Maybe, bring some chaos to the world along the way too?

It's going to be fun. Trust me.

CHARACTERS

KOKONOKA

The head of THE CURSED MANSION where everything is going to end. She's a witch too, and she'll help and coordinate you inside THE MACHINE.

MUIKA

She is THE GREATEST WITCH herself. Bittersweet inside, and would probably try to kill you if something goes wrong. In another words... the perfect wife.

SERVANTS

They'll make sure you'd feel at home. That's it.

NARRATOR

It's your inner thoughts that kinda feel like they don't belong to you. The further you go, the more intrusive they become.

FEATURES:

  • a comedy love story with some psychological horror elements and eerie atmosphere;

  • lots of dialogue options to choose from;

  • 3 endings, but you need to survive to reach them...

  • ...so there's also a plenty of dead ends to get.

Scenario fully written by MAHOUMAIDEN, author of REFLEXIA Prototype ver., so everything you loved about her previous work is going to be included in this game too <3

TECHNICAL FEATURES:

  • if played perfectly, you can finish this game within an hour or two;

  • awesome FULLHD resolution with backgrounds made from MAHOUMAIDEN's personal photos of Japan;

  • charming witchhouse soundtrack from STRDST;

  • big breasts, of course.

short_description: You've stumbled upon an invitation letter to MARRY THE WITCH. It's addressed to SATAN, which you are not... but who cares? You've decided to give it a try, and now you found yourself with a crazy girl stuck in some MACHINE. You can't leave, and your only option now is to survive and MARRY her.
